steps.message: What is the location of my Coding challenge event in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the location only.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar|fossify'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar|fossify'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo '---calendar_provider---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id:title:eventLocation | grep -i 'Coding challenge' || true; echo '---run_as_db---'; run-as com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro ls -la databases 2>&1"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "echo '---calendar_provider---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id:title:eventLocation | grep -i 'Coding challenge' || true; echo '---run_as_db---'; run-as com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro ls -la databases 2>&1""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for u in content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.provider/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.provider/calendarevents content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.provider/event; do echo '---' $u '---'; content query --uri $u 2>&1 | head -n 40; done"
